GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat Mid Field 3 Wide 4 Lengths 1000m, losing ground Wide before the corner and did not finish race off # did not come on
Jumped Ok Settled Just Off Mid-Field 6 Lengths . Straightened Up 4 Lengths off, failed to respond to hard riding # weak when counted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1000m had to be checked, made contact with the running rail and lost its position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly went back to tail 11 Lengths . last into Straight & Hard Ridden , Out Of Picture Soon After & was Not Sighted To Line # didn't fire a shot
Jumped Ok Settled Just Off Mid-Field 8 Lengths . came the widest on the Turn Straightening Up in Middle Of Track 5-6 Lengths off, didn't run on as expected # no threat today
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled 2nd last 7 Lengths . became held up turning for home, got Clear near 200m now 2 Lengths off, charged Through Took over & kicked strongly to score # overcame bother
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear ground from the entrance to the straight until inside the 300m

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back Worse than midfield rails 5 Lengths 1000m, angled off fence before the corner, looked winner when peeled off heels at 200m but Just peaked soon after and had to settle for minor placing # run peaked 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: lost its off fore plate enroute to the barriers and required to be re-plated on arrival at the barriers. Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was deemed suitable to start. Inconvenienced on jumping away when contacted by a/r

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Not Bustled Worse than midfield Two Wide 5 Lengths 1000m, came Four Wide from the corner and chased home well enough without getting close # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly Settled 2nd last 8 Lengths . Straightened Up out in Middle Of Track , only Battled to the line # no threat today
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: began awkwardly and shifted out. Near the 1000m commenced to race keenly and was steadied when awkwardly placed near the heels of a/r.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled Worse than midfield Two Wide 12 Lengths 1000m, Hard Ridden soon after Straightening Up and weakened last 200m # weakened 200m
Jumped Ok raced keenly back 3rd last 7 Lengths . got to Middle Of Track on Straightening Up now 4 Lengths from the Leader , ran on well taking Lead Inside final 50m # Finished Too Well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok ended up Wide No Cover Just Off Mid-Field 7 Lengths . Hard Ridden turning for home, Battled on okay (winner led) # wide/battled ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover throughout the event. shortly after pasing the 1200 m was inconvenienced  when taken wider by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok then Drifted Back 2nd last 7 Lengths . Straightened Up 4 Lengths from the Leader , worked to line fairly to finish 4th (gap back to rest) # Made Some Ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: inside the 100m was momentarily held up behind a/r and shifted out.
